capabilities: Show a preview card when hovering an external link
Display bare URLs as page titles
Render a URL alone on its line as a link card
Exclude individual notes with a link-peek: off property
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Privacy section states hovering sends one GET request to the link's site with no telemetry. Building from source is documented in docs/development.md.
problem: Obsidian's hover previews work for internal links, but external URLs show nothing about the page they point to.
summary: Hover preview cards for external links: shows the page's title, description and image in Live Preview, Reading view, Canvas and Bases.
